_notes: Distances from standard sea-distance tables. Transit days = distance / (laden service speed of the vessel class in vessels.json x 24) plus a 5 % sea margin, plus one day for a canal transit, rounded to the day: the same convention as the voyage estimate, so the Calculator and the Freight page agree. 'market' holds the destination's pricing: for index-priced commodities a delivered price differential vs the benchmark; for concentrates the destination smelter's TC ($/dmt) and RCs ($/lb or $/oz payable). Differentials and non-benchmark TC/RCs are ILLUSTRATIVE assumptions to show the arbitrage mechanics, not assessments; all are editable in the app. 'voyage' (optional) overrides the vessel-class defaults of the voyage estimate for that route.
